data.description:
## testing_mode: RED

## What
Create tests/scripts/test-check-precondition-emit.sh with 7 test functions. Create fixture files (simulated unified diff output) under tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/. All tests FAIL because the script does not yet exist.

## Test Architecture
The hook script will accept DSO_STAGED_DIFF_FILE env var to read diff from a file instead of running git diff --cached. Tests set DSO_STAGED_DIFF_FILE to fixture paths.

## Trigger Keywords
'fall through', 'safe fallback', 'log a warning and continue', 'continue without', 'fall back', 'graceful degradation'

## Target Files (only these 11 are checked by the hook)
plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/approval-gate.md
plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md
plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/test-failure-dispatch-protocol.md
plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md
plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md
plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md
plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md
plugins/dso/skills/validate-work/SKILL.md
plugins/dso/skills/shared/workflows/epic-scrutiny-pipeline.md

## Test Functions (all FAIL — script absent)
1. test_trigger_no_landmark(): diff adds 'fall through' to a target file; no EMIT-PRECONDITIONS in hunk → expect exit 1
2. test_trigger_with_nearby_landmark(): diff adds 'fall through' to target file; EMIT-PRECONDITIONS appears 5 lines after in same hunk → expect exit 0
3. test_trigger_with_distant_landmark(): diff adds 'fall through'; EMIT-PRECONDITIONS appears 11 lines later (beyond N=10 window) → expect exit 1
4. test_suppression_annotation(): diff adds 'fall through # precondition-emit-ok' to target file → expect exit 0 (suppressed)
5. test_preexisting_not_flagged(): diff has context line (no '+' prefix) with 'fall through'; no additions with trigger → expect exit 0
6. test_non_target_file(): diff adds 'fall through' to a non-target file (e.g. README.md) → expect exit 0
7. test_no_trigger_keyword(): diff adds prose to target file with no trigger keywords → expect exit 0

## Fixture Files to Create
tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/trigger-no-landmark.diff (unified diff header + hunk with + 'fall through' line, no EMIT-PRECONDITIONS)
tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/trigger-with-nearby-landmark.diff (same but EMIT-PRECONDITIONS 5 lines after trigger)
tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/trigger-with-distant-landmark.diff (EMIT-PRECONDITIONS 11+ lines after)
tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/trigger-suppressed.diff (trigger with # precondition-emit-ok annotation)
tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/preexisting-not-flagged.diff (trigger in context line ' ' not '+')
tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/non-target-file.diff (trigger in README.md diff header)
tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/no-trigger-keyword.diff (normal prose addition)

Each fixture must use proper unified diff format:
--- a/plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
+++ b/plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 context
+added line (with + prefix)

## .test-index RED Markers
Add one per test function: plugins/dso/hooks/check-precondition-emit.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-precondition-emit.sh [test_trigger_no_landmark]
(and similarly for each of the 7 functions)

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Test file is executable
   Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-check-precondition-emit.sh
2. Fixture files exist
   Verify: test -f tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/trigger-no-landmark.diff && test -f tests/fixtures/precondition-emit/trigger-with-nearby-landmark.diff
3. All 7 RED markers in .test-index
   Verify: for fn in test_trigger_no_landmark test_trigger_with_nearby_landmark test_trigger_with_distant_landmark test_suppression_annotation test_preexisting_not_flagged test_non_target_file test_no_trigger_keyword; do grep -q "check-precondition-emit.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-precondition-emit.sh \[\]" .test-index || exit 1; done
4. Tests fail (script absent)
   Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-check-precondition-emit.sh; test $? -ne 0
data.title: Write RED test fixtures and test suite for check-precondition-emit.sh (7 failing tests)
